sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's EV-bus adoption is structurally accelerating via VKTR's local manufacturing and government fleet mandates, creating a durable revenue base independent of global subsidy cycles.
US inverter and storage names (SEDG, ENPH) benefit from multi-year grid modernization and behind-the-meter resilience demand, underpinned by IRA tax-credit bankability.
Hydrogen (PLUG) faces policy whipsaw risk, but long-term green-hydrogen mandates in Asia and Europe keep the sector's optionality intact despite near-term volatility.
sectors.ai: Buy dips on SEDG and ENPH as US inverter demand re-accelerates on grid capex and IRA clarity; add VKTR for Indonesia EV-bus rollout momentum. Trim PLUG on hydrogen subsidy uncertainty. Watch RUN for distributed-solar margin recovery. Maintain overweight on NRG for contracted power resilience.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Indonesia's consumer sector is increasingly correlated to US equity sentiment, making global risk appetite a durable near-term driver of local FMCG valuations.
Mid-cap consumer names with low institutional coverage (BRRC, AGAR, COIN) offer outsized alpha versus large-cap staples, driven by domestic distribution expansion and digital channel adoption.
Persistent rupiah stability and easing input costs for packaged food and personal care producers support margin recovery, underpinning sustained earnings upgrades for agile local brands.
sectors.ai: Buy dips in mid-cap consumer names (BRRC, EL, AGAR) as US-driven risk appetite lifts IDX FMCG; rotate out of laggard staples into high-beta movers with earnings catalysts, but trim into strength above +15% given WATCH signal and likely mean-reversion.
